summary: BSTR Holdings, Inc. and BSTR Newco, LLC filed an 8-K disclosing termination of the business combination agreement with Cantor Equity Partners I, Inc. (CEPO), a SPAC, and related parties. The termination was effective August 20, 2026, after CEPO announced on July 8, 2026 that revised terms were being discussed and the original deal would not close. Under the Termination and Release Agreement, the seller agreed to pay CEPO $15 million in cash: $10 million by September 19, 2026, and $5 million by December 1, 2026. Ancillary documents were automatically terminated concurrently. The termination was under Section 10.1(a) of the agreement. Watch for potential litigation or alternative transactions.
